description: Blueberry Hill Farm is a working u-pick farm in 101 Reservoir Road, TN. It grows Blueberries, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
